claims.description: The definition-of-done baseline and bounded execution record are preserved.
Consent-ordering behavior is covered across every externally visible quick-check variant.
Invalid request-schema input returns 400 before session lookup, consent enforcement, or dispatch.
Missing and scoped-hidden sessions retain 404 under withdrawn consent without LLM dispatch.
An existing topic-scoped session returns consent-denied 403 before context lookup or LLM dispatch.
An existing topicless session uses the same consent boundary and returns 403 before general dispatch.
Active-consent topic and topicless paths dispatch exactly once while preserving context and response behavior.
The final quick-check boundary is represented by structural coverage.
The manifest and guard encode scoped lookup before consent and consent before a metered LLM callsite while retaining route-owned metering.
The complete regression-proof record is preserved as a tracked artifact.
Focused regressions cover both hidden-session exits, both existing-session consent denials, and both active-consent dispatch contexts.
The exact focused command, exit codes, counts, failure parity, and restoration hashes are recorded for all four phases.
The live-AC routed validation command and exact outcome are recorded.
Scope and authority limits are documented against the final diff.
The implementation remains within the four expected collision files plus lifecycle evidence.
Ownership hiding, lookup, response, routing, metering, and all prohibited surfaces remain unchanged.
The exact-head adversarial review requirement is recorded as an external landing gate whose authoritative state remains on the PR.
